youtube.title: Coke's Red Has No Paint Code. Why? 🔴 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Nothing about cola is red: not the taste, the color, or any ingredient. Yet Coca-Cola calls its red a second secret formula. Over time it stopped being decoration and became the signal that the cold drink had arrived. Today it's one of the most recognized colors on Earth, and there's no official paint code for it. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #Coke #Branding #Color #thehiddenwhy

instagram.caption: Nothing in cola is red, yet Coke's red is so powerful the company calls it a second secret formula. And there's no official paint code. You just know it when you see it. More on our channel. #thehiddenwhy #cocacola #branding #color
